fact: The MUIIS project (2015-2019) in Uganda profiled about 250,000 smallholder farmers, had about 7,000 individuals subscribed to its satellite-based advisory and index-insurance services, and reached or trained about 450,000 individuals.
title: MUIIS - Market-led User-owned ICT4AG Enabled Information Service
publisher: Netherlands Space Office, Geodata for Agriculture and Water (G4AW) facility
